notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 58 percent of top casts) alongside Life Tap on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Dropped the shared preset's prepull Demonic Sacrifice (18788): the talent tree names that id as the tier 2 Demonology talent's own spell, but the build's spellconst has no entry for 18788 at all, so this build cannot cast it under that id -- a concern for the engine lane to resolve (either a different cast id for the sacrifice effect or the talent is not yet implemented client-side). Corruption and Life Tap were kept from the shared preset. Fixed the same stale Shadow Bolt rank the preset carried (25307 cast at rank 9 where the build's current top rank is 10). Immolate and the Bane of Agony curse maintenance from the shared preset were dropped -- Demonology's own capstone is meant to be Decimation (440870), a talent that is supposed to drop Soul Fire's 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit. Fix round 1 (superseded): Decimation was reported as having no implementation in sim/warlock. Rotation-accuracy program (2026-09-28): sim/warlock/soul_fire.go now wires Decimation for real (applyDecimation: up to 90% cooldown reduction passively, plus the 10 s post-crit cast-time/cost window) -- but the guide's own recommended level-60 build (web/src/content/guides/warlock/demonology.md) spends 0 of Decimation's 2 points, rushing past it to reach Demonic Pact instead, so on THIS build Soul Fire still only comes off cooldown once a minute; the level-60 ladder golden confirms 17924 (rank 2) casting on that flat cadence. The guide's rotation prose is corrected to say so rather than describe a Decimation synergy this exact build does not take. Soul Fire is still placed ahead of the Shadow Bolt filler so it fires the instant it is off cooldown either way. Rotation-accuracy audit, engine numbers (2026-09-28): Corruption's and Soul Fire's base damage in sim/warlock carried classic tooltip values roughly double spellconst/warlock.json's own flat per-rank amount; fixed in the fork with a regression test each, which is why this spec's DPS dropped in this round's golden refresh -- the cast set and priority order are unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

Warcraft Tavern: Classic Demonology Warlock DPS rotation

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Corruption is cheap sustained damage that does not compete with Shadow Bolt casts.

Soul Fire on cooldown. The engine implements Decimation (440870, sim/warlock/soul_fire.go's applyDecimation) for a build that takes it, but the guide's own level-60 build spends 0 of its 2 points to rush Demonic Pact instead, so on this build Soul Fire just casts on its flat, unshortened 60 second cooldown.
Shadow Bolt is the default filler and what feeds Decimation's proc.

Shoot (5019, core.RegisterShootSpell) is the wand-weaving fallback added by the rotation-accuracy program's caster-wand finding (2026-09-28): sim/warlock never enabled a ranged auto attack or registered a Shoot action, so a leveling warlock's equipped wand dealt zero damage even though the ladder harness always equips one. Placed beneath Life Tap's own 10 percent gate above and gated below 20 percent mana itself, so Life Tap keeps first claim on refueling mana with health and Shoot only fills the band above that where Shadow Bolt is no longer affordable. Warlocks have no Wand Specialization equivalent, so this casts at the wand's plain damage.
